clients.name: AltStore
clients.instructions: Tap to add the source to AltStore.
clients.description: The reference sideloading client: it signs apps with your own Apple Account and keeps them installed by refreshing them over Wi-Fi.
clients.requirements: AltServer on a Mac or PC (AltStore Classic), or an EU Apple Account on iOS 17.4+ (AltStore PAL).
steps: Install AltStore — AltStore Classic needs AltServer on a Mac or PC; AltStore PAL (EU, iOS 17.4+) installs directly and is notarized by Apple.
Add this source: the link below opens AltStore on the Add Source screen, or use AltStore → Settings → Sources → Add Source.
Install from the catalog. A free Apple Account keeps two apps installed alongside AltStore and re-signs them every 7 days; a paid developer account extends that to 90.
clients.bestFor: The reference client, and the EU option (AltStore PAL, iOS 17.4+) that installs with no computer.
clients.effort: AltServer on a Mac/PC, or an EU Apple Account
clients.cost: Free Apple Account (7-day re-sign) or a paid developer account (365 days)

clients.name: SideStore
clients.instructions: Tap to add the source to SideStore.
clients.description: An AltStore fork that refreshes on the device through its own local VPN — you need a computer once, to install it, and never again to keep apps alive.
clients.requirements: A computer once, for iloader; LocalDevVPN installed and connected on the device.
steps: Install SideStore with iloader on a computer (iOS 15+ and a device passcode are required), then install the LocalDevVPN app and keep it switched on while installing or refreshing.
Add this source: the link below opens SideStore on the Add Source screen, or use SideStore → Sources → Add Source.
Install from the catalog; SideStore refreshes its own apps on-device, so nothing has to be plugged in. The free Apple Account limits still apply.
clients.bestFor: Most people: free, and after one computer setup it refreshes on the phone with no computer attached.
clients.effort: A computer once (iloader) + LocalDevVPN kept on
clients.refresh: Automatic on-device through its local VPN
clients.cost: Free Apple Account (7-day re-sign) or a paid developer account (365 days)

clients.name: FlareStore
clients.instructions: Tap to add the source to FlareStore. If nothing happens, paste the feed URL in Sources.
clients.description: An AltStore-compatible store with extra signing and repo tools. OmniSource recommends FlareStore for one-tap source install.
clients.requirements: A signing certificate, TrollStore, or FlareStore's own sideload path.
steps: Install FlareStore from flarestore.app and trust its certificate if asked.
Add this source: the link below opens FlareStore's importer, or use Sources → Add and paste the URL.
Browse the catalog and install. Re-sign when your certificate expires.
clients.bestFor: No computer at all, or no weekly re-signing: it can sell/attach a ~1-year signing certificate.
clients.effort: Install the app and import a certificate
clients.refresh: Certificate lasts up to a year; no weekly refresh
clients.cost: Free with your own certificate, otherwise a paid certificate

clients.name: Feather
clients.instructions: Tap to add the source to Feather.
clients.description: A source browser and installer for jailbroken, TrollStore-equipped or certificate-holding devices: Feather lists sources, installs from them and leaves refreshing to you.
clients.requirements: A jailbreak, TrollStore/ERE, or your own signing certificate.
steps: Install Feather — it needs a signing path of its own (jailbreak, TrollStore/ERE, or your own developer certificate).
Add this source: the link below opens Feather's source importer, or use Feather → Sources → Add Source and paste the URL.
Browse the catalog and install. Apps installed through TrollStore never expire; anything signed with a certificate has to be re-signed from Feather when it runs out.
clients.bestFor: Jailbroken or TrollStore devices, where apps are not limited by Apple's 7-day signing window.
clients.effort: Jailbreak, TrollStore/ERE, or your own certificate
clients.refresh: Depends on how the app was signed; TrollStore apps never expire
clients.cost: Free on TrollStore/jailbreak; otherwise your own certificate

clients.name: ESign
clients.instructions: Tap to add the source to ESign. If nothing happens, open ESign → App Sources → + and paste the URL.
clients.description: A signer rather than a store: ESign reads AltStore-format sources, then re-signs and installs each app itself — no companion computer, but also no background refresh.
clients.requirements: A certificate you trust on the device (Apple Account, self-signed or enterprise).
steps: Install ESign (signed with an Apple Account, a self-signed certificate or an enterprise certificate) and trust that certificate under Settings → General → VPN & Device Management.
Add this source: the link below asks ESign to import it; otherwise open ESign → App Sources → + and paste the URL.
Open the source in ESign and tap install — ESign signs and drops the app on your home screen. Re-sign from the same menu before the certificate expires; nothing happens automatically.
clients.bestFor: Signing IPAs by hand with a certificate you already trust.

clients.name: Ksign
clients.instructions: Tap to add the source to Ksign. If nothing happens, open Ksign sources and paste the URL.
clients.description: An ESign-style on-device signer: import AltStore sources, re-sign IPAs with your certificate, and install.
clients.requirements: A certificate you trust on the device (Apple Account, self-signed or enterprise).
steps: Install Ksign and trust the signing certificate under Settings → General → VPN & Device Management.
Add this source: the link below asks Ksign to import it; otherwise paste the URL in Sources.
Open the source and tap install. Re-sign from the same menu before the certificate expires.
clients.bestFor: An ESign-style on-device signer with source import.

clients.name: LiveContainer
clients.instructions: Tap to add the source to LiveContainer. If nothing happens, open LiveContainer → Settings → Sources and paste the URL.
clients.description: Runs sideloaded apps inside containers, so one signature covers all of them — but LiveContainer is itself installed through another client, so add it where you install apps today.
clients.requirements: AltStore 2.2.1+, SideStore 0.6.2+, TrollStore or a jailbreak — to install LiveContainer itself.
steps: Install LiveContainer with AltStore 2.2.1+ or SideStore 0.6.2+ (the LiveContainer+SideStore build goes in through Impactor or iloader; TrollStore and a jailbreak work too).
Add this source in LiveContainer → Settings → Sources — version 3.7.0 and newer also accept the one-tap link below.
Install apps from inside LiveContainer: they share its signature, so they do not each take one of your Apple Account slots.
clients.bestFor: Running many apps under one signature without spending App ID slots.
clients.cost: Free (rides on the host client's signature)
